title: Credit Builder Accounts Early-Closure Late-Fee Relief Amount
content:
The early-closure late-fee relief on a Credit Builder Accounts account is the base relief share of the late fee, rounded to the cent. The base relief share is 0.2, that is 20 percent.

## The fee the relief applies to

The relief applies to the account's most recent late fee; when two late fees were charged on the same day, the one booked first counts as the most recent. The relief is not owed, and nothing is booked, when the account has no late fee, when its most recent late fee already carries a fee waiver or a fee payment, or when the relief comes to 0.00; a late fee the borrower still owes is one carrying neither. A late fee carries a waiver or a payment when a fee waiver entry or a fee payment entry points at it.

## The amount

The relief share is applied to the late fee's amount; a relief share is never more than 100 percent (a share of 1.0). The relief is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end, a half cent or more rounding up, and it is never more than the fee.

| Most recent late fee | Carries a waiver or payment? | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| none on the account | not applicable | not owed |
| 12.00 | yes | not owed |
| 12.00 | no | 20 percent of 12.00, that is 2.40 |
| 7.33 | no | 20 percent of 7.33 is 1.466, rounded to 1.47 |

## Same-day fees (hypothetical)

Two late fees dated the same day: the one booked first is the most recent fee for this relief. If that one already carries a waiver, the relief is not owed, whatever the state of the other fee.
